# MS 365 ERP for UAE Businesses: Choosing and Implementing Dynamics 365

MS 365 ERP usually means Microsoft Dynamics 365, not the Microsoft 365 productivity suite. This page explains which Microsoft product is the ERP and which edition suits a UAE or GCC organisation. It also sets out what UAE VAT and e-invoicing require from the system. You also get a cost-driver table and a phase-by-phase view of your team's input. Together, these help you compare partner proposals on equal terms.

**Quick answer:** No. Microsoft 365 is the productivity suite, with tools such as Outlook, Teams and Excel. Microsoft's ERP is Dynamics 365. UAE businesses have two ERP options: Dynamics 365 Business Central for small and mid-sized companies, and Dynamics 365 Finance with Supply Chain Management for larger, multi-entity or manufacturing-heavy organisations. Both connect to Microsoft 365, Power BI and Copilot.

[Image: MS 365 ERP explained: Microsoft 365 productivity tools connected to Dynamics 365 ERP for UAE businesses]

## Microsoft 365 vs Dynamics 365: which one is the ERP?

### Is Microsoft 365 an ERP system?

No. Microsoft 365 is a productivity suite for email, documents and meetings. Microsoft's ERP is Dynamics 365. Business Central suits small and mid-sized companies, and Finance with Supply Chain Management suits larger, multi-entity organisations. The two connect, so ERP data reaches Outlook, Excel, Teams and Power BI.

Microsoft 365 holds no general ledger, inventory, purchasing or VAT records. On its own, it is not an ERP system.

| | Microsoft 365 | Dynamics 365 |
|---|---|---|
| Purpose | Email, documents, meetings | Finance, operations, CRM |
| Example tools | Outlook, Teams, Excel | Business Central, Finance, Supply Chain Management |
| Holds financial data | No | Yes |
| Runs VAT and invoicing | No | Yes |
| Connection | Approvals in Outlook and Teams, analysis in Excel | Feeds Power BI; Copilot works across both |

### Is Microsoft Dynamics 365 an ERP system?

Partly. Dynamics 365 is a family of business applications that are licensed separately. Business Central and Finance with Supply Chain Management are full ERP systems. They cover finance, purchasing, inventory and operations. Sales and Customer Service are CRM. Most UAE organisations choose one ERP edition and add CRM apps when needed.

UAE finance and IT leaders often ask us this, because Microsoft sells the apps separately under one name. For the full product map, read our answer to [is Microsoft Dynamics 365 an ERP system](https://www.techand.ai/insights/is-microsoft-dynamics-365-an-erp-system).

## Choosing your MS 365 ERP edition: Business Central or Finance and Supply Chain Management

### Business Central or Finance and Supply Chain Management: which should I choose?

Choose Business Central if you are a small or mid-sized company with a few entities and standard trading, service or light manufacturing processes. Choose Finance with Supply Chain Management if you run several legal entities across countries, complex manufacturing or warehousing, or group consolidation that needs enterprise-level controls.

Business Central vs Dynamics 365 Finance and Supply Chain Management for UAE organisations:

| Criterion | Dynamics 365 Business Central | Dynamics 365 Finance + Supply Chain Management |
|---|---|---|
| Entities and countries | A few, mainly UAE | Many, across the GCC and beyond |
| Operations | Trading, services, light assembly | Complex production and warehousing |
| Consolidation | Standard multi-company | Group-level, enterprise controls |
| Growth plans | Organic regional growth | New countries or acquisitions |
| Migrating from | Dynamics NAV or GP | Microsoft Dynamics AX |
| Needs from you | Small core team | Process owners per function and entity |

### When Business Central is the right ERP solution

Business Central is a packaged cloud ERP covering finance, sales, purchasing, inventory, project management and service. Start here unless entities, operations or consolidation already strain your current system. See [Dynamics 365 Business Central in the UAE](https://www.techand.ai/dynamics-365-business-central-uae).

### When you need Finance and Supply Chain Management

Partners often call this pair Finance and Operations (F&O). It adds depth for intercompany trading, production and warehousing. The trade-off is a larger project and more of your team's time. See [Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations in the UAE](https://www.techand.ai/dynamics-365-finance-and-operations-uae).

[Author insight: the most common edition-selection mistake you see in UAE scoping sessions, and how to avoid it]

[Image: Decision flow for choosing Dynamics 365 Business Central or Finance and Supply Chain Management in the UAE]

## MS 365 ERP modules: what is Microsoft Dynamics 365 used for?

### What is the use of Microsoft Dynamics 365?

Microsoft Dynamics 365 runs the financial and operational core of a business on one cloud platform. Its ERP applications record each step from purchase to payment and from order to cash. Its CRM applications handle sales and customer service. Teams then work from the same data, not separate spreadsheets.

- Financial management, including VAT and bank reconciliation
- Purchasing and inventory
- Sales orders and invoicing
- Project management and billing
- Manufacturing and supply chain

For business intelligence, Power BI reads ERP data directly, so reports no longer depend on exports. Power Automate routes approvals. Power Apps gives warehouse staff simple mobile apps. The result is one source of financial data, fewer manual re-entries and a faster month-end close. Microsoft continues to invest in the platform: Dynamics 365 revenues grew 19% year over year and 17% in constant currency in the second quarter of fiscal 2026 ([source](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/CRM/pressreleases/1068216/can-dynamics-365-growth-unlock-further-upside-for-microsoft-stock/)).

## UAE VAT and e-invoicing readiness for Dynamics 365

### Can Dynamics 365 handle UAE VAT and e-invoicing requirements?

Yes, when configured correctly. Business Central and Dynamics 365 Finance support UAE VAT set-up, reporting and audit trails. E-invoicing needs a connection to a provider accredited under the Ministry of Finance's e-invoicing framework, using Peppol PINT AE. Arabic layouts and multi-currency are also part of a standard UAE set-up.

Peppol (Pan-European Public Procurement Online) is the exchange network, and PINT AE is its UAE invoice specification. Take these questions to any partner meeting:

- **VAT returns:** Do return figures drill down to ledger entries?
- **E-invoicing:** Which accredited provider do you connect to, and who maintains it?
- **Arabic layouts:** Are Arabic invoices standard or custom-built?
- **Multi-currency:** How are AED revaluations handled?
- **Payroll add-on:** Does it cover gratuity and the Wage Protection System (WPS)?
- **Free zone and mainland:** Can both entities run in one tenant?
- **GCC cloud region:** Which Azure region hosts our data, and does it meet our residency rules?

For technical detail, read our guide to [upgrading your ERP for Peppol PINT AE compliance](https://www.techand.ai/insights/upgrading-your-erp-for-uae-peppol-pint-ae-compliance-a-technical-integration-guide).

[Author insight: the compliance question UAE finance teams most often raise at the start of a Dynamics 365 project]

[Image: UAE e-invoicing flow from Dynamics 365 ERP through an accredited Peppol provider]

## Is Microsoft Dynamics the same as SAP, and what is agentic ERP?

### Is Microsoft Dynamics the same as SAP?

No. Microsoft Dynamics 365 and SAP are ERP products from different vendors. Dynamics 365 works closely with Microsoft 365, Power Platform and Azure, which suits organisations already using Microsoft tools. The right choice depends on your processes, your integration needs and the partner who will implement and support it.

### What is agentic ERP?

Agentic ERP is an ERP system in which AI agents carry out multi-step tasks, such as matching invoices to orders or following up on approvals, with a person reviewing the outcome. In Dynamics 365, this runs through Copilot and custom agents built in Copilot Studio, under role-based access and audit controls.

Each agent should act only within its user's permissions, log every action and wait for sign-off before posting. Microsoft's [Future of ERP trends report](https://info.microsoft.com/ww-landing-future-of-erp-trends-report.html?LCID=EN-US) covers AI-supported ERP in more depth.

## Dynamics 365 ERP project costs in the UAE

### What drives the cost of a Dynamics 365 ERP project in the UAE?

Scope drives cost, so a reliable figure cannot come from a price list. The main drivers are the edition, users, entities, data migration, integrations, reporting, training and support after go-live. Ask every shortlisted partner to price the same written scope, so that you compare like with like.

| Factor | What moves it | What to ask your partner |
|---|---|---|
| Edition | Enterprise scope is larger | Why this edition for us? |
| Users | Number and licence type | Which roles need full licences? |
| Entities and countries | Each adds set-up and testing | How will entities be phased? |
| Data migration | Volume from NAV, GP, AX or others | How much history moves? |
| Integrations | Banks, e-invoicing, POS, CRM | Which use standard connectors? |
| Reporting | Power BI scope | Which reports are included? |
| Training | Users and change support | Who trains key users? |
| Support model | Hours and response levels | Is 24/7 support included? |

## How Tech& (legal name: Techand systems LLC) delivers Dynamics 365 ERP in the UAE

We are a Microsoft partner based in Dubai Airport Freezone (DAFZA), with 20+ years of industry experience. We serve UAE and GCC organisations in sectors including BFSI, the public sector, hospitality, trading and manufacturing, and retail. From Dubai, we run NAV and GP migrations to Business Central and AX upgrades to Finance and Supply Chain Management. We also deliver multi-entity and global rollouts.

[Microsoft partner designation and specialisations, if held]

Step 1. We review your processes and recommend an edition. You provide process owners and current data samples. See [our Assess & Envision approach](https://www.techand.ai/whatwedo/assess-envision).

### Build & Implement

Step 2. We configure the system, set up UAE compliance, migrate data and test. You provide key users for testing and sign-off.

### Run & Optimise

Step 3. We provide managed services and 24/7 support. You provide a named system owner.

Use this checklist with any partner:

1. Proven UAE VAT and e-invoicing delivery
2. Migration experience with your source system
3. Stated support hours
4. A named project team
5. A written scope

[Approved client case study: add once a client signs off]

## Book an MS 365 ERP scoping call

In one call with our Dubai-based Dynamics 365 team, we review your current systems, entities and UAE compliance needs. We then send you a written edition recommendation and scope outline. After go-live, 24/7 support is available.
